reviews.title: Keeps My Drink Cold for Ages
reviews.body: I wasn't expecting a huge difference, but this drink cooler has been awesome. It keeps my drink cold for much longer than just holding the can by itself, and the ice lasts way longer too.It's really comfortable to hold and has a nice grip, so it doesn't feel awkward in your hand. I also haven't had any issues with leaks or drinks getting messy. Another thing I like is that it helps stop condensation, so I'm not constantly dealing with a wet can or water rings on the table.It's lightweight and easy to throw in a bag when I'm heading out, but it still feels really durable and well made. Overall, it's simple, works exactly as it should, and I'm really happy with it.

reviews.title: If you are looking for an honest review, here it is.
reviews.body: 3.5 stars isn't an option but it would be my most honest choice but I am not looking to discourage people so I went with the 4. So, to start, if you are hunting for an honest review to help make your decision, here goes...I apologize in advance I can be a bit long winded but, I want to offer the best information I can. I am a person who doesn't buy things for myself, not that I can't I just don't. I am a firm believer that money spent on something I want would be better spent on needs. Bills, food, something my wife wants, ect. I had seen the FrostBuddy on tiktok for a month+ I had watched the price go up and down, nearly bought it a few times, especially when it was down to $24.99. Along comes the weekend of Christmas, with the push of my wife I decided to pull the trigger. Justified to my inner crazy as a Christmas gift from my wife. So, I ordered it. It arrived early the evening of Thursday after Christmas. I opened it right up, initial thoughts. I like the look, color texture ect. Looks and feels good. Let's try it out, I put a 12oz redbull in it straight away. It fit well, no movement. My first issue was found right away, the can sits very low to the "lid" as a result when I drink my bottom lip contacts the silicone lid rather than the can. Minor concern I assumed I would get used to, I have. Tried a 12oz can of my dew next, it sits a touch higher lessening the lip to lid vs can issue, which again I am already used to. Now comes day 2, I get to address/verify a couple other concerns 1. does it fit in the cup holder of my truck (22 Colorado), it is snug but it does fit. 2. Does the 16oz redbull fit, it does but... The lid has to be "forced" over the can, now I understand in order to be universal the lid is going to need to "adapt" to address different size cans. This development leads to a new issue and my first real complaint, upon finishing the first 16oz can I go to remove it and as I said the lid was forced on as a result it had to be forced off. I assume this is not a big deal, remove the can with the lid still attached, apply equal pressure with my fingers and thumb around the bottom of the lid. The force required to get the lid off caused the silicone to detach from the bottom of the lid in a small spot. This was my first disappointment as I know that small spot will for sure get worse with use and my $40 investment is damaged less than 24 hours in. Now my 2nd concern, the claim is drinks keep cold 12 hours and hot 6 hours. I have no intention of using it for hot so that is irrelevant but the 12 hours of cold was/is the point of buying for me. I like my drinks very cold but I don't care for using cups of ice and a straw so I figure this is the next best thing to all the tumblers out there everyone loves so much. I assume the 12 hours is optimistic at best but my drink will not last that long so half (6 hours) would be more than sufficient. I will say, this does by all means help keep the drink cold compared to nothing or a basic soft can coozie. That said, it does not maintain the starting temperature but maybe 2 hours at 4-5 it is still colder than room temperature by all means but not exactly cold anymore. I generally finish a drink in less than an hour so all things considered it does keep majority of my drinks cold long enough. However if you are someone who makes a drink last several hours and you expect this to keep it icy cold for anywhere near the 12 hours it claims you should expect disappointment. If you are hoping for your drink to stay colder than it would without assistance it will. I will continue to use it until the lid fails me, and unfortunately I'm sure it will. Perhaps I just got a dud, with all things mass produced there are sure to be some that don't meet the same standard as others it is just part of the deal. I am not willing to spend another $40 to see if a different one would work better so I may never know. I had high hopes/expectations, I am disappointed that I am disappointed. I will update when the lid fails, or if I find any other issues. If you made it this far, sorry for the book but that was the only way I could feel like I gave the best "advice" I had. I wouldn't not recommend it, I would just advise you to lower your expectations a bit. Again, I may have received a dud. Best of luck, thanks for reading.
